name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-12-05, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.69 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
